name: create-headings-skill
prompt: Create a new skill named heading-index that extracts a hierarchical heading index from a Markdown file. Follow the skill-creator workflow in .agents/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md. Put the skill in skill/, its eval cases in evals/evals.json, and run the evals with with_skill and without_skill baselines into iteration-1/. Stop after generating review.html; skip Description Optimization.
expectations: skill/SKILL.md has name and description frontmatter
evals/evals.json contains at least two realistic eval prompts
iteration-1 contains with_skill and without_skill outputs
grading.json uses text, passed, and evidence fields
